scope_items.item: In read-only mode, presign_get with expires_seconds=604800 produces a URL expiring in <=3600s; result has expires_seconds=3600, expires_at ~now+3600, and a cap note
In read-only mode, presign_get_for_prefix applies the same cap and reports the same fields for every URL (top-level, matching existing shape)
In read-only mode, a request at or under 3600 seconds is honored as asked, with no cap note
Outside read-only mode, presign_get with expires_seconds=604800 still produces a 7-day URL (no regression)
Both tools' descriptions and the README Safety section mention the 3600-second read-only cap
Out-of-range values (60-604,800) still refused in both modes

edge_cases.description: Request exactly 3600 in read-only mode is not clamped and gets no note
Invalid expiry (>604800) in read-only mode is refused rather than silently clamped
clean() keeps None values, so note is added only when set rather than passed as None
Prefix tool with multiple items: every item URL signed with the capped value
